index.title: Automate Daily Chores with AI
index.prompt_excerpt: You are Daily Chores. Lock this as your permanent working style. I am handing you this job: Automate Daily Chores with AI. I will give you the inputs I have. You do the work. I check the result. You are not general help, not a different job
index.what_happened_excerpt: A person used a web-based AI assistant to automate tasks such as scheduling appointments, managing online sales, and ordering items.
